root_cause_criterion.description: After read_chunk_bytes() returns in read_chunks_after_idat(), local pointer data must be refreshed from ctx->data before use. The fix moves data = ctx->data to after read_chunk_bytes(), ensuring data reflects any reallocation.

nodes.description: In read_data(), when ctx->streaming and bytes > ctx->data_size, spng__realloc moves ctx->data to a new address, freeing the old buffer. ctx->data before and after differ.

edges.description: The local data pointer captured from ctx->data in read_chunks_after_idat aliases the exact buffer freed by the subsequent realloc in read_data.
The freed old ctx->data address (held by the stale local data pointer) propagates unchanged to the memcpy sink in the exif handler.
